# Files that are corrupt on purpose in the pinned upstream archives.
#
# The corpus run treats a `failed` status as an error unless the file name
# matches a pattern below. Every pattern must name a file that a human has
# confirmed to be broken upstream; a broad pattern hides real regressions, so
# the gate warns when a pattern stops matching anything.
#
# Nothing else may appear here. A valid file that fails is a bug in Tzim.
#
# Format: one shell glob matched against the corpus file name (basename).

# Pillow 11.3.0, Tests/images — fixtures for its own error handling.
pillow-broken.png
pillow-broken_data_stream.png
pillow-truncated_end_chunk.png
pillow-truncated_image.png
pillow-truncated_jpeg.jpg
pillow-truncated_app14.jpg
pillow-truncated_exif_dpi.jpg
pillow-xmp_tags_orientation_exiftool.png
